scope: Production rollout of the phase-1 review follow-up to v2.dwdcc.kr after exact-SHA CI and isolated validation, as requested by the user (deploy once validation passes). Same schema (20); no settings, Keycloak or migration change.

server.build: cargo build --release --locked in a separate clean clone at the source commit
server.tool: scripts/core-rollout.py from that clone (inspect READY, then apply PASS); release directory .local/release-027caab-core

ui.tool: scripts/ui-rollout.py build/inspect/apply --expected-commit; backup .local/release-027caab-ui/production-backup; 3 new assets, 106 identical

ci.gate: core-rollout.py preflight verified these runs for the exact commit (new CI gate).

notRun.check: Signed-in production browser use (portal apps, console approval, same-tab app navigation)
